lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Tuesday's Town Council meeting, where second reading of the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code comes to a vote — that's a real Land Use Code change covering landscaping, trees, and historic review standards that will affect property owners across town. Same day, the Telluride Housing Authority takes up a proposed policy on primary residency for dependents in split-custody households, a quietly consequential question for working families in deed-restricted units. Thursday, Planning and Zoning digs into three Town-owned development projects — including the Carhenge Redevelopment — all moving through formal subdivision and concept review.
